name: databaseConnect
description: Triggered when the timer storage opens

name: databaseFail
description: Triggered when the timer storage could not be opened

name: timerCancel
description: Triggered when a timer is cancelled by hand

name: timerDrop
description: Triggered when a stored timer is thrown away without running, with the reason in $eventData[dropReason]

name: timerFire
description: Triggered when a timer's code runs: a timeout going off, an interval ticking, or a cron coming round

name: timerPause
description: Triggered when a timer is put on hold

name: timerRestore
description: Triggered when a stored timer is picked back up after a restart

name: timerResume
description: Triggered when a timer on hold is started again

name: timersReady
description: Triggered once startup has dealt with every stored timer

name: timerStart
description: Triggered when a timer is scheduled
